question: Through whose grace has the determination of Kaula become known to the speaker?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The object known is the determination of Kaula
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has understood the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
